# Pending lines of FuzzVIPDifferential (vip_differential_fuzz_test.go), the
# differential test of VIP-31.
#
# One line per construct of vipgen the compiler does not implement yet,
# keyed feature:<construct>, owned by compiler, naming its VIP and the lane
# that implements it. TestVIPConstructs runs every construct's probe, also
# under -short: a pending probe that passes fails as XPASS, so the lane that
# lands the construct deletes its line. Campaigns leave pending constructs out
# unless VIBELANG_FUZZ_PENDING=1. A generated program's gaps are keyed
# compile:<code>/<construct> and exit:<aspect>/<construct>. A construct's
# plain form (key suffix -plain) stands in a plain program, so it is compared
# before VIP-1's effect functions compile; one with no feature line is
# generated by every campaign.
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip01.effect-function  compiler  VIP-1: `effect function f(p) { … }` is not parsed and lowered as a function returning its body's Effect unrun yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.try              compiler  VIP-5: `try e` inside an effect function does not run the Effect e and give its success value yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip04.throw            compiler  VIP-4: `throw e` inside an effect function does not fail the Effect with e, as Effect.fail(e) does, yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip02.effect-block     compiler  VIP-2: `effect { … }` is not lowered to an Effect that reruns the block each time it runs (Effect.gen) yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.catch-value      compiler  VIP-5: `x catch v` does not run x and give v on a failure (Effect.catch(x, () => Effect.succeed(v))) yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.catch-function   compiler  VIP-5: `x catch (e) => f(e)` does not run x and give f(e) on a failure, a throw in f a defect (Effect.catch(x, (e) => Effect.succeed(f(e)))) yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.catch-effect-function  compiler  VIP-5: `x catch effect (e) => { … }` does not run the handler's Effect on a failure, a throw in it typed (Effect.catch(x, (e) => Effect.gen(…))) yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.catch-effect-block  compiler  VIP-5: `x catch effect { … }` does not run the fallback block's Effect on a failure (Effect.catch(x, () => Effect.gen(…))) yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip06.globals          compiler  VIP-6: succeed, fail, die and sync are not globals that name Effect.succeed, Effect.fail, Effect.die and Effect.sync yet; lane vip-globals implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip06.try-promise      compiler  VIP-6: tryPromise is not a global that names Effect.tryPromise yet; lane vip-globals implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip13.error          compiler  VIP-13: `error Name { n: number }` is not lowered to a Data.TaggedError class, thrown and caught with `x catch (e) => f(e)` (VIP-5's table), yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip16.data           compiler  VIP-16: `data Name { V0; V1 { n: number } }` is not lowered to Data.taggedEnum constructors yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip28.generic-data   compiler  VIP-28: generic `data Name<A, B> { … }` with up to 4 type parameters is not lowered to Data.taggedEnum yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork                   compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkChild(e)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-in                compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork.in(scope) e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkIn(e, scope)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-scoped            compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork.scoped e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkScoped(e)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-detached          compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork.detached e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkDetach(e)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.join                   compiler  VIP-17: `join f` is not lowered to `yield* Fiber.join(f)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.all                    compiler  VIP-18: `try.all [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.all([a, b], { concurrency: "unbounded" })` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.race                   compiler  VIP-18: `try.race [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.raceAllFirst([a, b])` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.any                    compiler  VIP-18: `try.any [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.raceAll([a, b])` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.all-settled            compiler  VIP-18: `try.allSettled [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.all([a, b].map(Effect.exit), { concurrency: "unbounded" })` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip19.for-concurrent         compiler  VIP-19: `for concurrent (const x of xs) { … }` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forEach(xs, (x) => Effect.gen(…), { concurrency, discard: true })` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip22.uninterruptible        compiler  VIP-22: `uninterruptible { … restore { … } … }` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.uninterruptibleMask((restore) => …)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip22.interruptible          compiler  VIP-22: `interruptible { … }` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.interruptible(Effect.gen(…))` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip09.service            compiler  VIP-9: `service Svc0 { static readonly key = "app/Svc0"; base: number; get(n: number): number!! }` is not lowered to `class Svc0 extends Context.Service()("app/Svc0") {}`, got with `try Svc0` and called as `(try Svc0).get(n)` (VIP-10), yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip09.service-default    compiler  VIP-9: a service with `static readonly defaultValue` is not lowered to `Context.Reference(key, { defaultValue })`, usable with nothing providing it, yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip12.provide            compiler  VIP-12: `provide L, Svc0 = testSvc0 { … }` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.provide(Effect.gen(…), [L, Layer.succeed(Svc0, testSvc0)])` yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip14.modules            compiler  VIP-14: Effect's root modules (Option, Duration, Schedule, Schema, Stream, Effect) are not in scope without an import, nor Effect's Array module as `Effect.Array`, yet; lane vip-globals implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip20.for-try              compiler  VIP-20: `for try (const x of s) { … }` is not lowered to `yield* Stream.runForEachWhile(s, (x) => Effect.gen(…))`, continue as return true and break as return false, yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip21.producer             compiler  VIP-21: `effect function* p() { yield x … }` is not lowered to `Stream.callback((queue) => Effect.gen(…).pipe(Effect.andThen(Queue.end(queue))), { bufferSize: 1, strategy: "suspend" })`, yield as Queue.offer, yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip23.pipe                 compiler  VIP-23: `a |> f(%) |> g(%)` is not lowered to nested calls with each topic evaluated once into a temporary yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip15.schema           compiler  VIP-15: `schema S1 { f0: string; f1?: string; f2: "l0" | "l1"; f3: S0 }` and the alias form `schema S0 = "k0" | "k1"` are not lowered to `const S1 = Schema.Struct({ … })` and `const S0 = Schema.Literals([…])`, decoded with Schema.decodeUnknownEffect, yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip29.schema-error     compiler  VIP-29: `schema error E0 { f0: number; f1: string }` is not lowered to `class E0 extends Schema.TaggedError<E0>()("E0", { f0: Schema.Number, f1: Schema.String }) {}`, thrown, caught, encoded and decoded again, yet; lane vip-decls implements it
#
# Plain programs (vipgen.Program.Plain): every construct's plain form
# compiles today, and its Exit and events agree with the reference, but the
# compiler still lowers a plain function as an effect function. Keyed
# exit:called/<construct>, checked after the Exit and events, so these lines
# never hide another disagreement.
FuzzVIPDifferential  exit:called/vip07.match-plain  compiler  VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript ("neither keyword: plain JavaScript"), but `export function main() { … }` compiles to `Effect.fnUntraced(function* main() { … })`, so calling main() runs nothing of its body; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  exit:called/vip13.error-plain  compiler  VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript ("neither keyword: plain JavaScript"), but `export function main() { … }` compiles to `Effect.fnUntraced(function* main() { … })`, so calling main() runs nothing of its body; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  exit:called/vip16.data-plain  compiler  VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript ("neither keyword: plain JavaScript"), but `export function main() { … }` compiles to `Effect.fnUntraced(function* main() { … })`, so calling main() runs nothing of its body; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  exit:called/vip23.pipe-plain  compiler  VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript ("neither keyword: plain JavaScript"), but `export function main() { … }` compiles to `Effect.fnUntraced(function* main() { … })`, so calling main() runs nothing of its body; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  exit:called/vip28.generic-data-plain  compiler  VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript ("neither keyword: plain JavaScript"), but `export function main() { … }` compiles to `Effect.fnUntraced(function* main() { … })`, so calling main() runs nothing of its body; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  corpus:plain-main-cold  compiler  VIP-1: a function with neither keyword is plain JavaScript ("neither keyword: plain JavaScript"), but `export function main() { … }` compiles to `Effect.fnUntraced(function* main() { … })`, so calling main() runs nothing of its body; lane vip-core2 implements it
#
# Accepted VIPs no construct covers (TestVIPCoverage reads these). A
# not-runtime line names a VIP with nothing to run. A feature line owned by
# vip, whose reason starts "not generated", names a VIP whose construct file
# is not written yet: it is this target's debt, not the compiler's.
FuzzVIPDifferential  not-runtime:vip03              vip       VIP-3: A!E!R is a type alias for Effect<A, E, R>; it changes no Exit
FuzzVIPDifferential  not-runtime:vip27              vip       VIP-27: declaration output and @throws are checked by declaration identity, not by an Exit
FuzzVIPDifferential  not-runtime:vip30              vip       VIP-30: config files change no Exit; FuzzConfig checks them
FuzzVIPDifferential  not-runtime:vip32              vip       VIP-32: one pinned Effect version; NewWorkspace refuses any other
FuzzVIPDifferential  not-runtime:vip34              vip       VIP-34: compiler and tooling requirements change no Exit
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip26.top-level        vip       not generated: VIP-26's top-level await of a runner needs its construct file; runMain exits the worker
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip33.platform         vip       not generated: VIP-33's platform standard library needs its construct file
